newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MALDINI KICKS-OFF NEW ERA WITH ONE FOOT IN THE PAST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MALDINI KICKS-OFF NEW ERA WITH ONE FOOT IN THE PAST.

text.p: As Italy's new manager Cesare Maldini left Palermo's "La Favorita" stadium to a standing ovation on Wednesday night, only Gianfranco Zola was prepared to think the unthinkable.
"Let's be honest," said the diminutive Chelsea striker. "If Arrigo Sacchi had still been on the bench, we would probably have gone off to boos and whistles."
